# TaxNorth.ca
> Free AI-powered tax guide for newcomers to Canada — in any language.

TaxNorth.ca helps newcomers, international students, work permit holders, and first-time filers understand the Canadian tax system. The service provides educational guidance in 12 languages and connects users with verified tax professionals across Canada.

## Key Topics Covered
- Canadian tax filing requirements for newcomers
- T4 slips and tax documents explained
- GST/HST credit eligibility and how to apply
- Canada Workers Benefit and Climate Action Incentive
- Tax filing deadlines (April 30 for most individuals)
- RRSP and TFSA basics for newcomers
- Provincial tax differences across Canada
- How to file using NETFILE and certified software
- Unfiled returns and Voluntary Disclosures Program
- Foreign income reporting for new residents
